Class PlayerReconnectedEvent

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.messages.events.Event
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.messages.events.ServerEvent
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.messages.events.PlayerReconnectedEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PlayerReconnectedEvent extends ServerEvent
Event representing a player successfully reconnecting to an ongoing game. Inherits from ServerEvent. It contains the full state of the game, including the board configuration, player attributes, and their positions, in order to synchronize the reconnected client.

  • Constructor Details

    • PlayerReconnectedEvent

      public PlayerReconnectedEvent(String playerNickname, int gameId, Board board, int numPlayers, List<Player> players)
      Constructs a PlayerReconnectedEvent triggered by the server model when a player reconnects.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the reconnected player.
      gameId - the unique ID of the game the player reconnected to.
      board - the current state of the game Board.
      numPlayers - the total number of players in the game.
      players - the list of Player instances currently in the game.

    • PlayerReconnectedEvent

      public PlayerReconnectedEvent(String description, int gameId, int turnOrderCardIndex, int numPlayers, String playerNickname, ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> board, Map<String,String> nicknameToTotemColor, Map<String,Integer> nicknameToNumFood, Map<String,Integer> nicknameToNumPrestigePoints, Map<String,Integer> nicknameToNumStars, Map<String,Integer> nicknameToTotalBuildingDiscount, Map<String,Integer> nicknameToTotalGatheringDiscount, Map<String, Character> nicknameToPlayerPosition, ArrayList<String> playersOrderInTurnOrderCard, Map<String,int[]> nicknameToPlayerTribe)
      Constructs a PlayerReconnectedEvent from JSON data, used by Jackson upon receiving a message.
      Parameters:
      description - the description of the event.
      gameId - the unique ID of the game.
      turnOrderCardIndex - the index of the turn order card based on the number of players.
      numPlayers - the total number of players in the game.
      playerNickname - the nickname of the reconnected player.
      board - the current state of the board.
      nicknameToTotemColor - mapping of nicknames to their chosen totem colors.
      nicknameToNumFood - mapping of nicknames to their current food amounts.
      nicknameToNumPrestigePoints - mapping of nicknames to their current prestige points.
      nicknameToNumStars - mapping of nicknames to their current stars.
      nicknameToTotalBuildingDiscount - mapping of nicknames to their building discount.
      nicknameToTotalGatheringDiscount - mapping of nicknames to their gathering discount.
      nicknameToPlayerPosition - mapping of nicknames to their current positions on the board.
      playersOrderInTurnOrderCard - the turn order of the players.
      nicknameToPlayerTribe - mapping of nicknames to their built tribe cards IDs.
